intro.mcp: Choose a {{format}} file. Nodestro first shows what it contains; nothing is stored before you confirm. Imported services are switched off, have no token and no approved tools.
intro.connections: Choose a {{format}} file. Nodestro first shows what it contains; nothing is stored before you confirm. Imported connections have no secret and are not checked yet.
intro.collection: Choose a {{format}} file (ZIP). Nodestro first checks it and shows its documents; nothing is stored before you confirm. The documents are indexed again here; the settings of this workspace stay as they are.

preview.summary_one: The file contains {{count}} entry, {{refused}} of them refused.
preview.summary_other: The file contains {{count}} entries, {{refused}} of them refused.
preview.refused_one: {{count}} entry cannot be imported. An import stores all entries or none: correct the file and choose it again.
preview.refused_other: {{count}} entries cannot be imported. An import stores all entries or none: correct the file and choose it again.
preview.secrets: Secrets are never part of the file. After the import, enter them again where they are needed.

collection.name: Collection
collection.nameHint: The collection the documents go to; empty: the name in the file.
collection.exists: The collection {{name}} already has files. Choose another name, then check again.
collection.embeddingSame: The file was indexed with the same embedding model; the documents are indexed again here anyway.
collection.embeddingOther: The documents are indexed again with the embedding model of this workspace.

reenter: Imported entries never bring their secrets along. Enter them again where they are needed; until then the entries do not work.

help.title: Exchange files
help.summary: Exchange files move MCP services, service connections, knowledge collections and workflows between workspaces. They never contain secrets, and an import is previewed before anything is stored.
